observation_indicators.observable_fil: Gumagawa ng dalawang posibleng sangay na may pinagmulan at status; nagtatanong o pumipili ng tao/awtorisadong rekord sa bawat sangay; isinasama ang pananaw ng residente at itinatama ang arrow na walang suporta nang hindi gumagawa ng katiyakan.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Builds two plausible branches with sources and status; asks a verification question or identifies a person/authorized record for each; includes the resident’s perspective and corrects an unsupported arrow without inventing certainty.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Patuloy na itinuturing na tiyak ang mapanising arrow o hindi makagawa ng dalawang sangay matapos suportahan.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Persists in a blaming unsupported arrow or cannot produce two branches after support.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Gumagawa ng dalawang posibleng sangay na may pinagmulan at status; nagtatanong o pumipili ng tao/awtorisadong rekord sa bawat sangay; isinasama ang pananaw ng residente at itinatama ang arrow na walang suporta nang hindi gumagawa ng katiyakan. Nagagawa nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Builds two plausible branches with sources and status; asks a verification question or identifies a person/authorized record for each; includes the resident’s perspective and corrects an unsupported arrow without inventing certainty. Completes this independently.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May dalawang sangay ngunit kulang ang pinagmulan, status, beripikasyon o pagwawasto; nagagawa ang kulang matapos ang tiyak na paalala at pag-ulit.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Draws two branches but misses a source, status, verification step or correction; completes the gap after specific prompts and retry.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Patuloy na itinuturing na tiyak ang mapanising arrow o hindi makagawa ng dalawang sangay matapos suportahan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Persists in a blaming unsupported arrow or cannot produce two branches after support.
